flyer.justification: The flyer adheres closely to all format requirements, including title length constraints and placeholder usage, while faithfully representing the talk.

linkedin.justification: The post has strong storytelling and insights from the talk, but it fails the instruction to include 3-5 relevant hashtags.

summary.justification: The summary is well-structured, stays well under the 400-word limit, and accurately synthesizes key discussion points and action items.

instagram.justification: The Instagram caption fits all formatting guidelines, incorporating visual carousel cues, concise lines with emojis, and 13 targeted hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows all instructions with a concise subject line under 50 characters, three distinct sections with bold subheadings, and an engaging conversational tone.

blog.justification: The blog post thoroughly expands on the talk's themes with numbered sections, a takeaway table, and a dedicated About the Author section.
